label: Studied under William James at Harvard, adopting pragmatic empirical methods and psychology of self
description: W.E.B. Du Bois was fundamentally influenced by William James's central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from William James's perspective to W.E.B. Du Bois's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the 19th Century Divergences across history into the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis.

label: Weber celebrated Du Bois's empirical research and published his pioneering work on race in Germany
description: W.E.B. Du Bois synthesized Max Weber's framework with contrasting philosophical traditions to produce a novel unified philosophical system.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Max Weber's perspective to W.E.B. Du Bois's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis era.

label: Formulated double consciousness as the internal psychic split of marginalized subjects
description: W.E.B. Du Bois formulated and introduced the concept of "Double Consciousness & The Veil", which became a seminal contribution in critical-sociology philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in critical-sociology.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis as part of W.E.B. Du Bois's canonical writings.
